SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-13: CQL - Date/Time Operators Part 1. Test these items: Add (left DateTime, right Quantity), After precision of, Before precision of, Date(year, month, day), DateTime(year, month, day, ...), Component From precision, Difference in precision between, Duration in precision between. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.title: Dynamic DateTime constructors lost hour precision formatting
issues.evidence: DateTime(year from @2024-01-01, 2, 3, 4) did not emit the CQL hour-precision DateTime shape.
issues.fix: Corrected dynamic DateTime constructor format strings so hour, minute, second, millisecond, and timezone forms preserve the authored precision.
issues.verification: Covered by CQL-13 datetime parity tests across forced Python fallback and native-loaded DuckDB.

issues.title: DateTime timezone constructor offsets lost fractional hours
issues.evidence: Runtime DateTime constructor offsets such as -7.5 and +5.5 were formatted as whole-hour offsets instead of -07:30 and +05:30.
issues.fix: Preserved timezone sign, hours, and minutes when building runtime DateTime values.
issues.verification: Covered by native-loaded and forced Python fallback constructor parity tests.

issues.title: Time from DateTime failed precision-aware extraction
issues.evidence: time from DateTime(...) did not reliably extract the time component, and day-precision DateTime values did not return NULL.
issues.fix: Routed one-argument Time construction over DateTime text through precision-aware extraction and NULL handling.
issues.verification: Covered by CQL translation/execution parity tests and direct dateComponent public-surface checks.

issues.title: DifferenceBetween lacked uncertainty-aware public helper parity
issues.evidence: Difference in precision between partial DateTime values needed the same scalar-or-interval VARCHAR public shape as DurationBetween, including native C++ availability.
issues.fix: Added cqlDifferenceBetween in Python fallback and native C++ registration, changed DifferenceBetween translation to use it, and routed uncertainty comparisons through cqlUncertainCompare.
issues.verification: Covered by direct SQL parity, no-Python/C++ surface tests, official CQL conformance, and full conformance.

issues.title: Partial DateTime marker forms were not preserved
issues.evidence: DateTime(2003), DateTime(2003, 10), and DateTime marker arithmetic lost the CQL DateTime marker T and could round-trip as Date strings.
issues.fix: Preserved year/month/day DateTime marker forms in Python translation, Python public helpers, and native C++ DateTime parsing/formatting.
issues.verification: Covered by translated parity tests and no-Python C++ dateAddQuantity precision assertions.

issues.title: Native dateAddQuantity widened partial DateTime precision
issues.evidence: C++-only dateAddQuantity returned over-specified DateTime values for hour/minute precision inputs and partial marker DateTimes.
issues.fix: Aligned native FormatQuantityDateTimeResult with the input lexical precision and marker form.
issues.verification: Covered by extensions/cql SQL tests and wasm/no-Python C++ surface assertions.

issues.title: dateComponent ignored lexical precision and time-only inputs
issues.evidence: Direct public calls returned components that were not present in the input precision and did not handle time-only strings consistently.
issues.fix: Updated Python fallback and native C++ dateComponent to infer precision from the input text and return NULL for missing components.
issues.verification: Covered by direct SQL parity tests and native C++ extension SQL tests.

issues.title: Scalar boundaries for duration/difference VARCHAR values regressed arithmetic and DQM
issues.evidence: Duration/difference helpers now return scalar-or-interval VARCHAR values. Comparisons, Truncate, div, /, and list aggregates could binder-fail or coerce interval JSON incorrectly. DQM temporarily regressed CMS0334, CMS72, and CMS128.
issues.fix: Added SQL-level uncertainty detection for comparisons, numeric function boundaries, / and div casts, static interval invalid handling for official div conformance, and list_sum/list_avg element casting.
issues.verification: CMS0334 targeted DQM returned 100%; DQM conformance passed 47/47; official CQL conformance passed 1706/1706; full conformance passed 2822/2822; full fhir4ds pytest passed 7180 with 5 skips.
